subject: No package XXXX found in local repositories specified

messages.author: 0325eb8c004c41a5
messages.subject: No package XXXX found in local repositories specified
parts:
Dear All,

I'm trying to upload a simple app to shinyapps.io, however, I get the following error:

R> shinyapps::deployApp('~/github/benchmarkme-data/inst/shinyExamples/plotting/')
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 83537...
Error in findLocalRepoForPkg(pkg, repos, fatal = fatal) : 
  No package 'benchmarkmeData' found in local repositories specified

The app depends on a package that is hosted on a github drat repo. I've tried adding

options(repos=c("drat"="http://csgillespie.github.io/drat/", 
                "CRAN"="https://cran.rstudio.org"))
library("benchmarkmeData")

to the top of server.R/ui.R, but I still get the same error. I've also tried various incantations of install_github and install.packages

Thanks

Colin
